Quiet space, quite pleasant to dine in
Jul 2026 • Solo
I like the atmosphere here because it is quite quiet, and the soft light makes me feel comfortable as soon as I walk in. I'll have a small steak and a glass of light wine. The grilled meat was just right, quite tasty, but it's a pity the side vegetables were a bit scarce. If there was an extra green salad, the meal would be more balanced. The staff are polite, attentive to customers, but not intrusive. Reasonable prices, especially in a tourist city like Nha Trang. If I have a chance to come back, I will consider stopping by.
